## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A three-fascicle Southern-Sòng treatise-and-letter collection by **Sìmíng Tiěwēng Shǒuyī** 四明鐵翁守一 ([守一](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%88%E4%B8%80), dates not preserved; resident from **1239** at *Tāizhōu Rìshān* 台州日山), the late-Sòng restorer of the *Nánshān* Vinaya school. Edited by his disciple **Xíngzhī** 行枝 ([行枝](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%A1%8C%E6%9E%9D)). The title *Zhōngnán jiāyè* — "The Family Inheritance of Mt Zhōngnán" — designates the doctrinal heritage of *Nánshān Dàoxuān* 南山道宣 (596–667), whose principal seat was Mt Zhōngnán in Cháng'ān; Shǒuyī, in lineage from *Rúān Liǎohóng* 如庵了宏, presents himself as the heir who must "keep up the family business." The full author signature reads *Sìmíng Tiěwēng zōngshī shù / ménrén Xíngzhī biān* 四明　鐵翁宗師　述／門人　行枝　編.

**Abstract**

The *Zhōngnán jiāyè* is **the principal Southern-Sòng *Nánshānlǜ* doctrinal compendium**, written at *Tāizhōu Rìshān* by Shǒuyī after he settled there in 1239 (Jiāxī 3). The collection is exegetically tied to *Yuánzhào* 元照's *Língzhī* corpus a century earlier (see [KR6k0167](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0167) *Sìfēn lǜ xíngshì chāo zīchí jì*) but engages on the technical level of Sòng *guānxīn* 觀心 doctrine: the *jiètǐ* (precept-substance), *chífàn* (upholding-and-violation), and *sēngtǐ* (the *substance* of the saṅgha) treatises in the middle fascicle revisit late-Sòng controversies. The most historically significant piece is in fascicle 1: *Dá Rìběn Réng fǎshī jiàoguān zhū wèn* — Shǒuyī's replies to the Japanese pilgrim-monk **Shunjō Réng** 俊芿 (1166–1227, founder of *Sennyūji* 泉涌寺 in Kyoto) on questions of *jiào* and *guān*. This is one of three Southern-Sòng *Lǜzōngwèndá* groupings (the others survive as [KR6k0256](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0256)). Composition is bracketed by Shǒuyī's residence at Rìshān (from 1239) and a defensible upper bound for his floruit; `notBefore`–`notAfter` are accordingly set 1239–1260. Companion volume: [KR6k0220](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0220) *Lǜzōng huìyuán*.
